result.title: Marginal-Preserving Coupled Diffusion Composition for Long-Horizon Planning
result.summary: Compositional diffusion planners extend short-horizon trajectory models to long-horizon goal-conditioned planning by generating and stitching multiple local trajectory chunks. However, in multimodal environments, local plausibility is not sufficient for global consistency: independently initialized chunks may denoise toward incompatible overlap modes, producing plans that are individually feasible but incoherent after stitching. Existing remedies typically add search, guidance, pruning, or graph-based structure at inference time, increasing computational cost or relying on task-specific machinery. We instead investigate graph-structured dependence among chunk-wise initial diffusion noises as a lightweight coordination mechanism for compositional trajectory planning. We propose \textbf{M}arginal-Preserving \textbf{C}oupled \textbf{D}iffusion \textbf{C}omposition (MCDC), a training-free inference method for pretrained compositional diffusion planners. Instead of sampling chunk noises independently, MCDC constructs coupled Gaussian initializations whose per-chunk marginals remain exactly standard Gaussian, as required by the pretrained denoiser, while neighboring chunks receive positively correlated noise components. This preserves the standard-Gaussian initialization marginal of each chunk while biasing adjacent chunks toward compatible overlap-mode choices. We prove exact marginal preservation and show, under a simple multimodal overlap model, that positive coupling increases the probability of compatible mode selection. On OGBench long-horizon stitch tasks, MCDC consistently improves over independent compositional diffusion sampling while retaining nearly the same inference time, and achieves a favorable success--cost trade-off compared with search-based composition methods.

AI.brief_summary: 提出免训练的 MCDC：不再独立采样组合式扩散规划器各轨迹块的初始噪声，而是构造正相关耦合高斯初值，使每块边际仍严格为标准高斯，从而在几乎不增加推理时间的情况下促使相邻块选择兼容的 overlap 模式；论文证明边际保持，并在简单多模态模型与 OGBench 长程拼接任务上验证。
AI.relevance_reason: 「保持各分量边际不变、仅通过耦合初值协调多个并行生成过程」的做法，可能为并行 latent 推理片段之间的一致性协调提供免训练、低开销线索；待核查其收益是否依赖轨迹 overlap 结构与预训练去噪器假设。
